H2802.derivation: from H2801 (חָרַת) (but equivalent to H2793 (חֹרֶשׁ)); forest;

H2803.def: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H2803.kjv: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

H2805.def: a belt or strap (as being interlaced)

H2806.derivation: from H2803 (חָשַׁב) and H1777 (דִּין); considerate judge;

H2810.def: a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination)

H2811.derivation: or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ; from H2803 (חָשַׁב) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has regarded;
H2811.def: Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites

H2813.derivation: from H2808 (חֶשְׁבּוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); thought of Jah;

H2819.derivation: from a root corresponding to H2818 (חֲשַׁח);

H2820.def: to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe
H2820.kjv: assuage, [idiom] darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.

H2821.def: to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
H2821.kjv: be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.

H2825.derivation: or חֲשֵׁיכָהxlit chăshêkâh corrected to chăshêykâh; from H2821 (חָשַׁךְ);

H2828.derivation: from the same as H2831 (חַשְׁמַן); enriched;
H2828.def: Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites

H2831.derivation: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently

H2832.def: Chasmonah, a place in the Desert

H2833.derivation: from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle;
H2833.def: perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest

H2834.def: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
H2834.kjv: make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.

H2835.def: properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest)

H2836.derivation: a primitive root; also interchangeable for H2820 (חָשַׂךְ)
H2836.def: to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically; to deliver

H2840.derivation: from an unused root meaning to bind together;

H2852.def: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) to decree

H2878.def: {properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter)}

H2882.derivation: from H2881 (טָבַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has dipped;

H2891.def: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)

H2896.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).

H2898.def: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
H2898.kjv: fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

H2899.derivation: from H2896 (טוֹב) and H138 (אֲדֹנִיָּה); pleasing (to) Adonijah;
